Messages.Author: Raille
Messages.Body:
Will the Final Nights card Set be playable?

Not quite 30 days between the release date and the tourney, so I thought
I'd ask, before I put anything together for this.

Raille

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Raille wrote:
>
> Will the Final Nights card Set be playable [at Origins]?

>
> Not quite 30 days between the release date and the tourney, so I thought
> I'd ask, before I put anything together for this.

Seems you've answered your own question.

The official release date for Final Nights is June 11. That makes Final Nights
legal in constructed deck events on July 11.

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) V:TES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/

There you have the problem with making occasional exceptions, as with last
November's European Championships or whatever it was. Regulars on Usenet

Messages.Author: Kevin M.
Messages.Body:
"Raille" <rai...@mich.com> wrote in message
news:3B240D5F...@mich.com...


As I am the one running the events at Origins this year, I will be happy
to answer your question. Feel free to bring up anything else you may
have questions about.

Since I did not ask LSJ for an exception to the rule, the rule is still
in place. I did not WANT to ask for an exception, since I felt, based on
8+ years of CCGing, that there would inevitably be some players that have
their Final Nights cards integrated into their decks, and some other
players that would complain, or whatever, because they don't have
"enough" cards, or haven't gotten "ready" for the new set. There IS a
logic to the 30-day rule, and it seemed to apply in this case.

> Raille

Yea, I understand. The trouble with it (and mind you, it's not that big a deal,
I'm just relating why I'm in sympathy with Raille about feeling the need to
post and ask the question) is that there's a tendency to wonder if I missed
something. "Hmmm, another big tournament coming up just sly of the deadline.
Someone _might_ have posted 'overriding text' somewhere and I just missed it."
And it really really really sucks to show up a CCG tournament with a deck built
to the wrong environment. So you get on the horn and specifically ask the
question so you can have a much more confident feeling about what you're going
to bring.

Fred

Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
Are Final Nights cards reprinted from previous cardsets legal in
tourneys prior to the 30-day deadline? e.g. Can I use the Dreams of
the Sphinx I picked up in the Giovanni FN starter in a tourney this
June?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Cards with the Final Nights sumbol on the are not legal for
constructed deck tournaments until July 11. Except for the two
that were released early (Hesha and Fatima).



Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> =====


I just must say that that basically sucks monkey IMO. There should be no
problems with reprinted cards that are not errataed as they have been around
since DS and AH. This gives players who have the DS and AH versions an edge
over players who *only* have the FN version of a card that does the same
thing, is called the same but is only different in its set symbol. What
about
players not able to trade for the AH versions and that started with SW??
They
might have bought more Giovanni starters to get those cards and now they
cannot use them merely because they got in the game 4 years later?? I
realise
and understand sets are only legal until 30 days after release, and
exeptions
are not made but who the hell is going to give a rat's ass about which set a
Dreams is from. It does the same. This leaves a kind of bitter taste in my
mouth.
No pun is intended by any means, Scott, just had to get this of my chest.

Tim Eijpe
